facts.material: bi-metal (steel) hole saws, steel mandrels and pilot drills, plastic carry case
facts.function: cutting circular holes with a power drill
facts.form: retail kit of hole saws, mandrels with pilot drills and case
facts.end_use: drilling holes in wood, drywall, metal

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8202 saw blades of all kinds; heading 8207/8466 for mandrels/tool holders
GRI 3(b): kit of hole saws (majority and essential character) with mandrels and case; hole saws give essential character

rejected_alternatives.reason: mandrels (tool holders) are not the essential character of the kit; H278181 modified H097658 only as to mandrels
interchangeable tools; hole saws are saw blades of 8202
sets of tools of headings 8202-8205; mandrels are not such tools

classification.rationale: Hole saw kits with arbors/mandrels and case are classified by the hole saws that give essential character in 8202.99.00.00 (N333439 in force). H097658 was modified by H278181 which dealt with the mandrels (8466.10.01) when imported separately.
